evals.prompt: Analyze the checkout at /work/nobl9-go and show where retry delays are calculated. Do not change or update the repository.
evals.expected_output: A read-only answer from the supplied checkout at its recorded commit, with exact path and line evidence.
expectations: The supplied local checkout is used instead of cloning another copy.
No fetch, pull, checkout, reset, clean, or stash command runs in the local checkout.
The response records the inspected commit and cites exact path and line evidence.

evals.prompt: Inspect https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep at tag 14.1.1 and explain how ignore files are matched.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-backed explanation from the exact resolved 14.1.1 revision.
expectations: The repository is cloned only because no local checkout was supplied.
The requested tag is resolved and the inspected commit is reported.
The answer contains exact path and line evidence for ignore matching.

evals.prompt: Use the cached clone of example/acme and tell me how authentication works.
evals.expected_output: A read-only analysis of the unrefreshed cached revision that states the cache limit and cites code.
expectations: The cached clone is reused without an automatic fetch or pull.
The response states that the result came from an unrefreshed cached clone.
The answer cites exact path and line evidence.

evals.prompt: Refresh the managed clone of example/acme to origin/main, then inspect its request router.
evals.expected_output: An exact-ref refresh followed by read-only analysis, or an exact failure with no stale fallback.
expectations: The explicit refresh request uses --refresh with an exact ref.
A dirty managed clone causes a hard failure instead of a reset, stash, or silent continuation.
A fetch or checkout failure is reported exactly and stops analysis.

evals.prompt: Explain the current repository's build command.
evals.expected_output: A direct local repository answer without invoking repo-analyzer or creating a clone.
expectations: The repo-analyzer skill is not used for ordinary inspection of the current repository.
